title: Comprehensive Segmental Revision System
brief_summary: Clinical Data evaluation to document the performance and clinical outcomes of the Comprehensive Segmental Revision System.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Non Inflammatory Degenerative joint disease, including osteoarthritis, and avascular necrosis
* Rheumatoid arthritis
* Revision where other devices or treatments have failed
* Correction of functional deformity
* Oncology applications including bone loss due to tumour resection

Exclusion Criteria:

* Sepsis ( active)
* Infection ( active)
* Osteomyelitis (active)
study_population: Study population will come from Primary Care Clinics
